# Apache Maven

<!-- Generated by tools/clientrecipes from src/maven.json; edit the source. -->

Read the [common setup and credential rules](README.md) first. [All recipes](index.md).

Client: **Maven 3.10.0 / Temurin 27; compatibility Maven 3.9.16 / Temurin 26**. Registered classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**.

Endpoint: `${AW_URL}/artifactory/${AW_REPO}`

## Before connecting

- Export AW_USER and AW_TOKEN; AW_USER must match the token subject.
- A valid Maven project with group/artifact/version and configured build plugins.

Authentication: Use an access or reference token as the HTTP Basic password, with AW_USER equal to its subject. The subject needs read permission for installation and deploy permission for publication on the selected repository; token scopes cannot exceed that identity. The same clients also accept a user password when Basic password authentication is enabled. Use HTTPS.

Fresh client state: Run in a new disposable pinned Maven container for every client session; also use distinct publisher-m2 and consumer-m2 under AW_WORK. This isolates Maven global settings, the Java user home, local artifacts and credentials.

## Configure

Maven interpolates the exported environment at invocation; settings.xml does not contain the token literal. Repository id aw must match the deployment or resolution repository id.

```sh
umask 077
AW_WORK=$(mktemp -d)
mkdir -p "$AW_WORK/home"
cat > "$AW_WORK/settings.xml" <<'XML'
<settings><servers><server><id>aw</id><username>${env.AW_USER}</username><password>${env.AW_TOKEN}</password></server></servers></settings>
XML
```

## Publish

Classes: **local, federated**. Publish to a local or one-node federated repository. Remote repositories are read-through caches; select the local deployment member when reading through a virtual.

Run in a valid Maven project with a pinned deploy plugin. package then deploy:deploy avoids installing the artifact into the consumer local cache.

```sh
mvn -s "$AW_WORK/settings.xml" -Dmaven.repo.local="$AW_WORK/publisher-m2" package deploy:deploy -DaltDeploymentRepository="aw::$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO"
```

## Install or resolve

Classes: **local, remote, virtual, federated**. Select a local, remote, virtual or one-node federated repository with read permission. Dependencies must also be available through that repository.

The tested artifact coordinates are examples; specify your package. A separate consumer repository ensures the artifact is fetched over HTTP. Build/plugin dependencies may come from Maven Central unless mirrored by your policy.

```sh
mvn -s "$AW_WORK/settings.xml" -C -Dmaven.repo.local="$AW_WORK/consumer-m2" org.apache.maven.plugins:maven-dependency-plugin:3.8.1:get -Dartifact=org.acme.smoke:lib:1.0.0 -DremoteRepositories="aw::default::$AW_URL/artifactory/$AW_REPO"
```

## Limits

Classes outside **local, remote, virtual, federated** are not registered for this format. Commands above apply only to each operation's listed classes. Federated evidence is for one node; it does not establish cross-vendor replication.

- Virtual deployment is deliberately omitted; deploy directly to the authorized local member.
- Client checksums remain strict (-C). A dependency already in consumer-m2 is not evidence of remote retrieval.
